title: Tales 001 - The Stonecutter
style: japanese folk storytelling ballad, shamisen, shakuhachi flute, koto, soft taiko, warm clear male vocal, gentle and wise, crisp diction, 92 bpm, very short song, vocals start immediately

lines: There once was a stonecutter who wished to be the mightiest of all
One day a rich lord passed him by
If only I were him, he sighed
But the sun beat down even on lords
I want to be the sun
So he became the sun and scorched the earth below
Then let me be the cloud
He rained and rained and flooded all the land
But one thing did not move
Until he felt something at his feet
Let me be myself, he whispered
Whatever you become, something will seem greater
Peace begins with who you are
